title: Implement botspy sources
description: botspy sources: inspect the source registry — every known source name, its resolved root (after --root/--home), session count from discovery, status. -v adds discovery detail. Spec: features/cli/sources.feature.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Done: botspy sources passes all 7 scenarios in features/cli/10_sources.feature. Registry entries carry name, agent, resolved root (after --root/--home/BOTSPY_HOME), session counts from the real adapters' discovery, and ok/missing status; --source filters to one; -o json/-o ndjson serialize the entries; unknown source exits 1 naming the known five; human output truncates long paths until --no-truncate. Sessions/show/doctor/snapshot tagged @wip until their verbs land, keeping the suite green. Gates: fmt, clippy -D warnings, full cargo test.
